title: Official ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Light Sticks Release Ahead of Global Tour — Here’s Where to Shop
summary: Great for concerts and sing-along viewings of the film alike, the light sticks feature five LED colors and more than eight lighting sequences.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Light sticks have become one of the defining accessories at K-pop concerts, turning arenas into coordinated displays of color as fans wave synchronized lights throughout a show. With Netflix officially announcing the KPop Demon Hunters global concert tour, fans can start preparing by picking up the official HUNTR/X and Saja Boys light sticks, along with other themed accessories, ahead of the highly-anticipated shows.

The fan tradition of waving light sticks during K-pop shows even made its way to this year’s Academy Awards during HUNTR/X’s performance of Golden . Audience members, including Emma Stone, Gwyneth Paltrow, Leonardo DiCaprio, Teyana Taylor and Chloé Zhao, were seen waving generic light sticks as the trio performed, bringing one of K-pop’s most recognizable concert traditions to Hollywood’s biggest stage.

Now, you can get your hands on an official KPop Demon Hunters light stick online.

OFFICIAL LIGHT STICK

'KPop Demon Hunters' HUNTR/X Light Stick

Batteries Included

Buy Now On Amazon

Buy Now at walmart

Designed after the HUNTR/X logo from the hit animated film , this electronic light stick features five LED colors and more than eight lighting sequences.

A button on the base cycles through the different effects, while an interactive mode lets it synchronize with compatible HUNTR/X light sticks nearby. Batteries are included, so it’s ready to use right out of the box.

INTERACTIVE LIGHT STICK

'KPop Demon Hunters' Saja Boys Light Stick

Modeled after the Saja Boys’ lion emblem, this light stick includes five color modes (pink, blue, green, gold and rainbow), plus more than eight lighting patterns.

It also features a synchronization mode that connects with other compatible light sticks in range for coordinated lighting effects. Batteries are included, and it’s designed to match the group’s darker demon vibes from the film.

The two light sticks measure just under 10 inches in height and are an officially-licensed release from Netflix and toymaker, Hasbro. The KPop Demon Hunters light sticks come ahead of a new concert tour inspired by the film, though exact dates and details have yet to be released .

Of course, you could also pick up the light sticks to bring to one of the upcoming K-pop concerts that have been announced . Light sticks are one concert purchase I recently regretted not buying. At BTS’ Arirang world tour stop at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas, I couldn’t find the highly-coveted orbs at the venue and stuck out like a sore thumb in my section as the only person empty-handed. So, consider this your friendly reminder to order the band’s official light stick before concert day — and don’t make the same mistake I did.

As for KPop Demon Hunters , you can also prep for the tour — or a sing-along night at home — with these wigs inspired by the HUNTR/X girls.

DRESS-UP WIGS

'KPop Demon Hunters' Wigs: Mira, Rumi and Zoey

Each Wig Sold Separately

$21.99

Bring your KPop Demon Hunters cosplay to the global concert tour with these wigs styled to match each HUNTR/X member’s iconic hair.

Made from heat-resistant synthetic fibers, each wig offers a soft feel, lasting durability, and maintains its shape through extended wear. Each package includes one wig and a wig cap, making it ideal for concerts, cosplay events, Halloween, conventions, stage performances and themed parties.

The KPop Demon Hunters light sticks drop online on the heels of a new Vans sneaker collaboration with the Netflix film, and a new Mattel doll collection inspired by HUNTR/X and Jinu from the Saja Boys.
